Q1.e: Stages 1 and 2: the keyed option is the hedged, balanced one ('가능성은 있지만 ... 더 꺼내 봐야 한다', '아직 정하기 어렵다') while the distractors use absolute words ('아무것도', '확신한다', '상관없이', '쓸모가 없다'). Solvable by tone alone. Stage 3 genuinely needs 19/50 vs x/10 (only 'd' is a weak distractor).

Q2.e: Single keyed option per stage is defensible (stage 3: 0.38 vs 0.4/0.5 - c; 5 beads = 0.5 is also 'possible' as the task itself admits but reasonable=['c'] only). Write step real run: '확실히 빨강이 많다고 할 수 없어. 횟수가 적으니까 더 해 보자.' and '...확실히 빨강이 많은 건 아니야. 더 꺼내 보자.' FAIL w2 because the none-pattern '확실히\s*(빨강|많)' matches the negated sentence; a good answer is shown a red check.

Q3.e: Very short text; needs 5-6th grade ratio comparison only in stage 3. 8 min fine.

Q4.e: Best diagnostic quality in the set: stage-1 a reveals the gambler's fallacy ('다시 넣으니까 앞에서 나온 색 때문에 다음 차례가 달라지지 않아요'), d reveals over-skepticism, c in stage 2 reveals over-reading of 9 vs 11.

Q5.e: Sample size vs confidence transfers to surveys, experiments.

defects: s2 w2 'none' pattern false-rejects the natural negated phrase '확실히 ... 할 수 없다'
suggestedFixes: Stages 1-2: make the balanced option not the only hedged/longest one (e.g. add a second hedged but wrong option such as '곧 파랑이 나올 가능성이 높으니 더 꺼내 봐야 한다')
s2 w2: replace with a pattern that matches only affirmative claims, e.g. '확실히\s*(빨강|많)[^.]*(이야|야|다)(?!.*(없|아니|않))' or drop the check

Q2.e: Real checker, s3 write: the natural correct answer '홀수 병은 불가능해요. 과자와 젤리 값은 100원 묶음으로 6, 4라서 짝수이고, 음료가 홀수면 합이 홀수가 되어 50이 될 수 없어요.' FAILS w3 ('불가능' contains '가능' and w3's first pattern is 홀수 병[^.]*가능); '음료가 홀수 병이면 가능하지 않아요. 남은 돈이 200의 배수가 아니라서요.' FAILS w3; '홀수 병은 다 가능하지 않아요' FAILS w3. 3 of 5 correct answers rejected. False acceptance: '직접 해 봤더니 안 돼요 그냥 안 돼요 진짜로' PASSES all checks (w1 '직접', w2 '못/안 돼' etc.). Build is correct: (4,4,2),(3,3,4),(2,7,2) accepted, (6,1,2) rejected (9 items), duplicate rejected; all 6 valid plans are acceptable (verified by enumeration).

Q4.e: s2 reveals explain why each strategy fails ('다 찾았는지는 알 수 없어요', '값이 서로 달라서 똑같이 줄여도 맞춰지지 않아요'). Hints are actions, though s3 hint 1 already hands over the 6/4/5 transformation.

Q5.e: Systematic enumeration by one variable and divisibility/parity as impossibility argument both transfer.

defects: s3 w3 none-pattern matches '불가능' and negated '가능하지 않아요' (rejects correct answers); w1/w2 so loose ('직접','못','표') that vacuous answers pass

Q2.e: Numbers verified: 27% (18/67), 86.9% (16.2/18.65), 41% (1.62/3.9475). Stage 3 value is correct but needs unlikely precise arithmetic; ranges are fine. s2 write real run: '양성이면 90%가 아니라 27% 정도예요. 정상품이 훨씬 많아서 ...' Wrong answer '양성이면 90% 불량입니다 ... 상관없어요' correctly fails.
